description: Source code for the HuggingFaceInference class implementing an LLM interface, including API integration, parameter handling, and streaming response logic.

classes.name: HuggingFaceInference
classes.description: A class extending LLM to interface with HuggingFace models, supporting streaming and API key management.

methods.name: _llmType
methods.description: Returns the type identifier for the LLM, 'hf'.

methods.name: invocationParams
methods.description: Prepares and returns parameters for API calls, compatible with chat completion API.

methods.name: _streamResponseChunks
methods.description: Streams response chunks from the HuggingFace API, yielding GenerationChunk objects.

methods.name: _call
methods.description: Makes a synchronous call to the API and returns the generated text.

methods.name: _prepareHFInference
methods.description: Initializes and returns an InferenceClient, optionally with a custom endpoint.
